node.title: XR SL-2 G-local primitive Pade-pencil parameter census
node.statement: At every prize-row depth ceil((2h+2)/3)<=d<=h-2 with rank J_d<2d and g=|G_d|>=2(h-d), let R_d^G be the maximal selected post-strip pairs for which every selected off-core block lies in G_d. The proved primitive Pade router writes the whole kernel as {(SP,SQ):S in W}, with gcd(P,Q)=1 and ell=max(deg P,deg Q)<=3d-2h-1, and writes every counted pair uniquely as (f0+Q tau,g0-P tau), deg tau<k-ell; distinct full cores intersect in at most k-ell-1 points. Then 25|R_d^G|<=17n^2-25(n-g). Maximality, first-match liveness, G-locality, and strip ownership remain load-bearing; no locator-pencil transport is assumed.
